SANTA ON TRAFFIC DUTY 🎅🏻🚦

Traffic enforcer Ramiro Hinojas directs traffic dressed as Santa Claus along Macapagal Avenue in Pasay City on Tuesday, December 23. 

Hinojas said he wears the costume during the Christmas season to lighten the mood of motorists caught in heavy traffic.

📸 The STAR/Edd Gumban

HOME FOR CHRISTMAS 🎄

Passengers flocked to Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3 in Pasay City on Tuesday, December 23, 2025, as the number of travellers increased with more people arriving and departing just three days before Christmas.

The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) reported that the country expects nearly a million passengers this holiday season, prompting them to be on "heightened alert status" to help manage airport congestion.

COURTESY: Danny Pata
